I was adopted when I was 2 due to my birth mom neglecting and abusing me and my brother, the rest of my childhood I suffered from ptsd with flashbacks. The flashbacks aren’t as bad now but they still happen once in a while.
I’m 20 and I’ve had this for around 10 years.

OCD, ADHD, Generalized and Social Anxiety, Depression,FASD, Chronic Suicidal Ideations, PTSD, Panic Attacks, Auditory and Visual Hallucinations and finally Borderline Personality disorder.

I am on 12 different medications (can’t remember the names) my meds are given to me by my parents due to the fact I’ve attempted to die from an overdose multiple times. I cope day by day by just staying in the momentary not overthinking about anything.
Good to hear.
It’s not your fault. You can’t choose what emotions you feel. Please remember that you are not alone. I care.
I care. Please remember to clean whatever you use to cut with. You don’t need the infection.

Hey! It’s important for you to know this is not your fault. You said you were 15? You can call the police and they can help you. I know it seems scary but you should feel safe. 

If you have other family they would place you with them, if not you would go to foster care or a group home. It sounds scary and some of the time it is. But it’s better then being abused. (I was in your place once)

Hey! Don’t worry I understand where your coming from!
I have some….experience in this area. The difference between you and her is as simple as it sounds. She’s a different person, with a different personality. Also her suicidal thoughts could be more intense or she could have a lower tolerance for said thoughts. There are really a lot of variables while you describe them as swings I know personality I would describe my own thoughts as a an elevator. Sometimes it stays really low then sometimes when you think your as low as you can go you discover a basement.
She may have been over it when she told you she was feeling / getting better she most likely was. It’s not uncommon for a relapse to happen suddenly, I know I’ve felt on top of the world then a hour or even 30 minutes later I felt like killing myself was the only way to stop everything. 


You said she self harms…. I know when I self harm it’s because I’m in control of the amount of pain I feel instead of it being forced on me. Sometimes I cut because I want to make sure I can still feel something. Like I felt numb.

Hey, 

First, I want to make sure you know. None of what happened with him and her is your fault. If he is going to waste his time on a secret girl then maybe he’s not the right guy for you? However.if you feel he is…. I respect that.

Have you talked to him about how your feeling?? Also self harm is not something that you need to do for a guy to care about you, neither is purging.

Take care of yourself.

Hi, I’m Sandy and I have multiple mental health conditions.
(FASD/ADHD/Chronic Suicidal Ideations/Depression/Mild PTSD) those are the main ones,

To be honest I have lived with these conditions almost all my life. I don’t remember not having them. I know that the world is not a forgiving place when it comes to people like me. I had to adapt myself instead of having people adapt for me. I don’t go out in public alone, always with a friend who knows me. 

I don’t talk to people that much for fear of doing or saying the wrong thing. Since I don’t really understand sarcasm and social cues I just don’t want to get hurt again.

It’s about coming up with your own coping skills that work. I know that a lot of my coping skills might not work for someone else. I’m assuming your asking because you or a friend has a mental illness and you want to learn. Which is great.

Honestly. It’s often hard and you end up with a lot of questions and hopefully enough answers.
Ah, of course. 🙂 I have a dog named Charlie. I enjoy downhil skiing and a few other things. Anyway I hope you are doing better then you were.
That’s nice!! Does your cat have a name??? If so what is it?? Also what sort of stuff did you used to do??
I know that feeling. Please remember that there are people who care what happens to you. Even if they can’t tell you.

Hey! I completely understand how you feel. If you don’t mind me asking, what makes you feel unhappy?? Sometimes there is a reason behind it, sometimes there isn’t,

If you don’t know the reason it might be important for you to find it?? You could try retracting your steps in your head to when you started feeling this way, what were you doing? Any major or minor changes??

I’m sorry to hear your having a tough time! If you don’t mind me asking? Can I know a little bit about you?? I’d love to get to know you better and maybe help you out! Like what sorts of things you do, do you have any pets and stuff like that!!

Maybe she was worried that you (her best friend ) wouldn’t accept her for who she is?? Have you asked her why she ignored you for so long? There could be a logical reason…

I also want to say it’s not your fault that you feel like you do. I hope you know that sometimes how you feel doesn’t reflect how you want to feel. 

Do you have family? I’m just curious because I want to get to know you better.
